title: Mrs. Michal Tawil: Lag Laomer- "What Rabbi Shimon Can Teach Us" (Class # 17)

chapters.title: The challenge of hosting
chapters.about: A woman's stressful experience with her mother's visits

chapters.title: The daughter's drawer
chapters.about: Defining the role of a daughter and learning from a mother

chapters.title: Finding the mother's Torah
chapters.about: Understanding the deeper meaning behind a mother's choices

chapters.title: Hosting vs. opening a home
chapters.about: Shifting from a hostess mindset to an open house

chapters.title: Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai's teaching
chapters.about: Avoiding mental idols and the need to impress others

chapters.title: Rebirthing our perspective
chapters.about: Rewiring thoughts to focus on Hashem and personal truth

summary: Mrs. Tawil discusses how to shift from a stressful mindset of hosting to a mindset of opening one's home, using the example of a woman struggling with her mother's visits. She explains how to avoid defining oneself through negative reactions or the desire to impress others, and instead connect to one's own 'emit' and the Torah of one's mother. The class connects these ideas to the teachings of Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai regarding the avoidance of idols and mental images.
questions: How can I stop feeling like a burden when my mother visits?
What does it mean to have an open house instead of being a hostess?
How do I stop worrying about what others think of my home?
How can I find the positive Torah behind my mother's actions?
What did Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai teach about mental images?
